name: Great Zimbabwe National Monument
scaleNote: 1 stud per metre. The Great Enclosure's wall is 11 m high over 250 m of run: the wall IS the site, and it has to read as coursed.

wallHeight.source: Wikipedia, Great Zimbabwe: '11 m (36 ft) high dry stone walls'.

wallRun.source: Wikipedia, Great Zimbabwe: 'walls as high as 11 m (36 ft) extending approximately 250 m (820 ft)'.

towerHeight.source: Wikipedia, Great Zimbabwe: the Conical Tower is '9 m (30 ft) high'.

towerDiameter.source: Wikipedia, Great Zimbabwe: the Conical Tower is '5.5 m (18 ft) in diameter'.

note: THE MOST LITERAL WALL IN THE ATLAS: dry stone, coursed, mortarless, modular -- a Klemmbaustein wall is a closer model of Great Zimbabwe than of anything else on this list. The enclosure is built as a ring of straight runs rather than a true circle, because `arrangeOn` bends instances and not walls; the cited 250 m of run is preserved.
